S0432.reason: English courts follow the rule that extra-territorial abduction does not bar prosecution or stay proceedings, though it may create liability for the abductor.

S0598.reason: Under the law of treaties, a reservation is invalid if it is incompatible with the object and purpose of the treaty.

S0272.reason: SDS coats proteins with uniform negative charge and denatures them so separation depends on molecular length rather than intrinsic charge or structure.
